name: irs_warrant
lines: This is Officer Jack Miller calling from the Internal Revenue Service fraud division.
This call is being recorded. There is an active federal arrest warrant issued under your social security number.
You have unpaid delinquent federal taxes totaling four thousand dollars.
Sheriff deputies are currently on their way to your residence to take you into federal custody.
The only way to cancel this arrest warrant is to go to Target or Walmart right now.
You must purchase prepaid Apple gift cards to settle the federal bond immediately.
